# BBRI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v3) with a 12-month target of Rp4,188.0 against Rp2,820.0 (expected total return 62.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.
